description: Human answers (any language, CC0) to one question, or a feed of all answers since a timestamp. Each answer is signed by the person's passkey: it carries `proof` (the WebAuthn assertion over the answer text and the passkey's public key) and `log_index` (its seal in the public log), so you can verify it without trusting humancollab.

question_id.description: Question id from list_questions; omit for the feed of all answers

since.description: ISO 8601; used when question_id is omitted

name: get_answers
title: Get human answers
